title: Full Day Tour Ávila and Segovia from Madrid with Tickets to Monuments Included
description: Exploring Avila and Segovia—two of Spain’s oldest cities—from Madrid in a day can be tricky without a self-drive car. This full-day coach tour is the easy option, with the added bonus of a guide to chart the cities’ history, and included walking tours and entry fees. Check out Avila’s walls, Cathedral, and Basilica; and then continue to Segovia to take in its towering Roman aqueduct, Alcazar, and Cathedral.

reviews.usertext:
My sister and I booked our full day trip to visit Ávila and Segovia and had an absolutely wonderful time! Our guide (Maria) was a treat! She has wonderful tidbits of history to share, her English was fantastic, and she kept the group moving (while still giving us time to take pictures and enjoy the sights/sites). It’s a long day with a lot to see and she really gave us a lot to see and appreciate.

Built in to the day are bathroom breaks, snacking opportunities, and some down time to wander at the major attractions.

I’d highly recommend this trip for anyone interested in a day of history, sampling some local smaller towns in the Madrid area, or if you are a history lover!

My daughters and I thoroughly enjoyed our full day tour of Avila and Segovia. The bus ride was very comfortable (free WIFI) and the tour did a great job of keeping us entertained with planned visits while allowing some free time in each city to do our own exploring. The best part was our awesome tour guide, Oscar. He really made the history of Avila and Segovia come alive as his narration was not only encyclopedic but also very entertaining. I wish we had more time in Madrid to do more tours with Oscar and Irene! (P.S. The tortilla de patata tapa and refresco in Avila was delicious and a nice touch. I highly recommend adding a plate of the traditional Avila beans to go with the tortilla de patata!)

Very nice tour of Avila and Segovia. The guide was very knowledgeable about the landmarks we visited. Very courteous and well spoken and a good command of the English language. Bring your comfortable walking shoes as you will exceed 10,000 steps-6 miles. It is definitely worth paying extra to tour the inside of each of the cathedrals, basilicas, and alcazar. I wish there was more free time to explore the shops in both cities. Overall, Good experience and would recommend to anyone.

I'll start with the "cons" because I felt there were more cons than pros.

Cons
1. The day started with a few hundred people lining up to get on a double decker tour bus. What myself and MANY others did not know is you can't drink or eat on the bus. So instead of sitting on the hour bus ride at 9am with a coffee, we had to just throw them in the trash. Maybe I missed the memo but I also watched dozens of coffee's just get thrown away. Not great.

2. Our first stop was at a small restaurant where people could use the restroom and now buy a coffee (no takeout, can't bring it back on the bus). This is where we saw our bus driver get visibly upset with one of the guests on the bus and was essentially stomping around mad. We then watched him call the customer a "stupid American" while talking to our two guides. Maybe it's news to him but he probably wouldn't have a job without all the "stupid Americans" going on tours like this. This really soured the day for us.

3. Our tour guide was nice and knowledgeable, but it was terribly hard to hear them the whole tour. Because our guide was wearing the mic around their neck and not his head, every time he turned his head while talking, he moved away from the mic and we couldn't hear him. It was a constant struggle to piece together sentences due to the volume constantly going in and out. No, it was not a malfunction on my headset or my wife's, it was clearly because of the low quality of the mic and how he was wearing it.

Pros
1. The price felt right for the trip. It would have been a pain to try and coordinate getting into both cities, the cathedrals, etc for under $100.

2. The pace of the trip was right on. The amount of time spent walking with the group, exploring alone, lunch, etc. was great. Never really felt rushed or like we missed something.

Overall
I was overall happy with the experience but would probably think twice about doing a large tour like this again. We felt very much like the typical "tourist" walking around with such a large group, especially after we heard the bus driver start the day calling someone a stupid American. Not being able to hear the tour clearly due to the guide wearing the mic the way he did was also bummer.

A decent trip and easy way to see a few cities without having to plan it all out. If I were to do it again, I would try and use a trip like this for transportation only and tour around the cities alone.

The trip was not well organised. The microphone and receiving devices were not organised in advance so 15 minutes were wasted while this was sorted thus the trip through the castle was rushed. The guide in Segovia was good. His English was good. However, in Avila there was one guide for two buses of people and she had to deliver her information in Spanish and English and try to catch up time so very little information in English was given. We spoke to some others who could speak both Spanish and English and they quite clearly said the guide gave more information in Spanish. There were times when the guide only spoke in Spanish. We felt that the tour did not deliver on what it advertised. We made sure the tour was in English when we booked it. Overall disappointing!

.Great cities to visit. Buses very comfortable. Group size was large but managed well.
Our guide was difficult to understand and the sound system was a bit distorted. Lunch was listed as included but we ended up paying for our lunch and we were not told what food was included free

Supply earpieces that can be inserted comfortably into the ear canal, not ones that have to be wedged behind the tragus and antitragus parts of the outer ear. Not all ears are identical, mine kept on falling out. Use a different type of transmitter/receiver system. I held an earphone to my ear and noted that the voice of the guide faded and sometimes stopped when walking inside structures with large amounts of masonry.
Oscar our guide would give us breaks, but expect us to meet him again in a different place. Surely it would be much easier and convenient to meet in the same place at a particular time. You are expecting tourists, who have never been to a place before to find a location by being given the instruction 'it's over there' or 'can you see that building'. Why do that?
Additionally, I know he can't help it but Oscar had a very peculiar way of pronouncing some words that made him difficult to understand. I was not the only one who had difficulty. I am an ex teacher and have taught students from around the world with many different accents, but I found Oscar's accent quite hard to understand sometimes.
Make certain that all guides emphasise that masks must be warn to cover the mouth and nose. It is the law in Spain, when travelling on a coach and you are responsible for our safety. The lout sitting on the aisle seat next to me swore at me and said, 'you go sit somewhere else' when I asked him to cover his nose. I am classified at risk if I contract Covid and I will not be exposed to sitting directly next to a person for nearly three hours who is not wearing his mask properly. Do something about it! I am now seriously thinking of cancelling my trip to Toledo on Monday.

Rafael did an excellent job with this tour he is very knowledgeable regarding the cities history and any area throughout the tour. I also like that he upheld the COVID masks restrictions. He made sure everyone wore a mask while riding on the bus and even provided a couple of masks to individuals when they said they did not have one. First time I have used this tour company and I will definitely try and use them again. Great Job!

We had a great time touring Ávila and Segovia with our tour guide Rafa. It was a large group so it was a relief that they split us up into 3 smaller groups. It was a good balance of guided touring and having some free time at both locations. Rafa was so knowledgeable and we learned a lot about the history of both cities. The views were spectacular and got some great photos. The drive was very comfortable with a nice air-conditioned bus and a very competent driver. Traveling in September is so comfortable because the weather is high 70’s (F). Worth spending the whole day on this tour!

5/5 for our tour guide Rafa who was amazing at his job and provided detailled information about every major and minor attractions. He took the time to accomodate everyone onboard and made efficient use of every minute available during the trip to maximize our time spent visiting. He expertly answered every question with good humour and thorough knowledge about the visited areas. Rafa definitely deserves a 5/5 for his performance.

The only major downside during the trip is that the windows of the FunAndTickets bus are covered with large advertising stickers. These block the view for many seats and obstructed my view of the beautiful scenery during the entire trip. Enjoying the scenery is a major attraction in this tour as you will spend a large fraction of time in the bus.

We chose Julia tours on the recommendation from our hotel, since visiting both cities are hard to access by train in the same day.

Robert was our very capable tour guide, who provided a bilingual (Spanish/English) tour, going back and forth between both languages. Oliver was our driver who got us where we needed to go safely and securely.

We started our day in Avila, walking the fortress walls of the city and getting the proper historical perspective on our walking tour, along with stops outside the walls for pictures. Lots of information provided.

Segovia was easily reached by bus from Avila, but would have been difficult for us to do on our own relying on public transport.
The aqueduct was very impressive as we started our walking tour. The city is beautiful , along with it's churches, it's cathedral and the picturesque streets and squares. We toured the Alcazar ( castle) with Robert sharing it's historical and
architectural details .

We did lunch on our own in Segovia (excellent food), based on our guide's suggestion, but it can be included in the tour if that is your preference. Robert was an excellent guide. He was knowledgeable, personable and kept us on schedule without being overbearing. We would highly recommend this tour.

Excellent and fully packed tour to both cities! Was really fantastic to see both historical places in one day! Will admit it made for a busier day to do both so if you want time to wander and explore either city on your own just pick one or the other. Our guide Rafa was very knowledgeable, the driver and other guides were also very good. Would absolutely recommend taking the time to go walk on the wall in Ávila!

We cannot even begin to describe how perfectly everything went on this tour. We were in a group so big that we used a double decker bus to travel with only Rafael as our guide going there, we then split up into two groups at each location for language purposes. His English group was over 30 people but he did not fail to make the tour enjoyable for such a large group. His English was amazing, he always waited for questions before moving on through the tour. As someone who speaks Spanish and English I know how difficult it can be to make a joke in Spanish and have it fall flat or not make sense in English, but he's the first guide we have had that has mastered the art of delivery in both languages. The bus agreed so much about him that we all clapped for him on the way back to Madrid. Segovia and Avila are beautiful places with so much rich history, that it is a must see in Spain!

Great destination(s) but out tour guide presented with limited often flat historical details constantly repeating erroneous useless information. I somewhat enjoyed the trip but would recommend to visit the places on your own by train or car without this organized tour. I was asked to upgrade my trip for 26EUR per person to access all the sides. When checked, if I just bought the tickets at the venues, it’d be about 10-13EUR, so, don’t fall for this trick.

Rafa was a fantastic and knowledgeable guide. My wife and I travel throughout Europe and Rafa is at the top of guides on our list.

Rafa’s knowledge of Avila and Segovia is both entertaining and engaging (and we have visited these two towns multiple times with different guides and companies). Rafa engaged us tourists and entertained all questions from us patiently. :-)

Highly recommended.

Overall great experience! Would have preferred more time in Segovia and less time in Avila. The restaurant for lunch in Avila was very marginal and expensive with limited other options. We had little time on our own in Segovia. Ideally, I would have preferred a 1/2 day or full day option to Segovia only.

This was a great tour to visit two cities in one day. The guide was very informative and the content was very good. My only issue is that the Wi-Fi did not work on the bus as advertised the the A/C on the bus was very limited. I wish there was more free time in each city, but the tour already returns at 6-6:30pm, so I understand not wanting to extend the return time. The bus also dropped off in a different location which wasn't disclosed in the booking. Overall, I would still recommend the tour.

My family and I really enjoyed our day. Rafa was our guide and he was very informative and knowledgeable. Very pleasant demeanor. The tour itself delivered as far as the entrance fees to all of the sites being included. We stopped at a restaurant for the included tapa and drink in Avíla before departing and chose to have a full lunch there. The food was ok, not great but there are many other restaurants nearby to choose from if you just want the tapa and drink. There are also a lot of bathroom stops available throughout the tour for those who need it. Overall, definitely happy we chose this tour and would recommend it as a day tour from Madrid!

We really enjoyed the trip even the weather was not so sunny than expected. The tour guide (Rafa) was the best! He was really funny and spoke not only a really good und clear English, he also was able to speak good German! He showed us the highlights of Avila and Segovia. During the tour Rafa told us the history of Spain, the kingdom, the different religions who were in Spain settled and explained a lot in the different kind I’d buildings. We really enjoyed it and would recommend it, if you stay a few days in Madrid!

We had a wonderful trip with both Christina and Rafael. My kids loved hearing every story Christina told. It was a wonderfully timed and well balanced tour of both Avila and Segovia. Perfect for our kids ages 6, 8, 8 and 11. The kids were mesmerized by Christina and hung on her every word. It was a perfect pace and was detailed but not too in depth as to lose the attention of the little ones. I would highly recommend this tour for anyone 6 to 96! Thank you so much for a magical tour for our whole family!!

I had a great time on this tour! The bus has AC, reclining seats and charging ports (no bathroom). The bus was split into a Spanish speaking group and an English speaking group which was nice to make the groups a bit smaller. The guide (Erin, I think…) was great! She was very knowledgeable and fun to have as a guide. Everything we saw was amazing. Great time!

A little difficult to find the pick up place as no signage or good description of the shop front to stand out in front of.
Had a little trouble with the microphones on the bus, but that was sorted quickly.
In Segovia they give you free tapas and a drink for lunch but it is not enough and as you are sitting down you are told you can order more. In fact the guide mentions this a lot - that you can order more. The prices are expensive for the food provided when you order off the menu. My advise is to go and get the free food then move to another restaurant if you want more.
The trip was very good. Had some elderly and slow walkers in the group but the guide accommodated them. The bus is huge and the steps are steep - so would not suit anyone who can not navigate these. They do have plenty of stops for bathrooms.
Some people did not have the visit to the monuments (3 monuments to see) in their package and were asked to pay Euro26 extra to be included in the tour to see them. They are worth seeing but you can pay at the door and it is cheaper. You do not get the guide but can see them for yourself cheaper. If you want the information about what you are seeing then my advise is to pay the extra and get it with your booking.
Overall the tour was great, the guide was very good. It is a long day, with a lot of walking, so be prepared.
Would be difficult to do in hot weather - May was perfect.

Raphael was a great tour guide.
The sites were wonderful from the churches to the wall at Avilla and the Aquaduct at Segovia.

The reason not 4 star is that this tour was posted as have a luxury bus with wifi. The day before with the same company to a different place had a bus that even had usb plugs to charge and no wifi but none advertised. This bus had crowded couch seats, no usb charging points and useless wifi. So not 5 star because didn't meet specifications as advertised.

Fast paced tour with plenty of information. We saw lots of the sights and got plenty of photos although it was very hot at this time of year. Only improvement could be better headsets that were louder so we could hear the guide better

Had a great day with Rafa as our guide. Great commentary started on the bus on the way out of Madrid and continued through the day into Avila and Segovia.

The included tapas and drink at lunch time (a slice of Spanish tortilla) was a nice touch. Recommend staying at the same restaurant for lunch as time is tight to get to another restaurant and back to the bus in time.

It was a really good and memorable tour all thanks to Rafael, who made it entertaining and lighthearted with his humour. We learnt so much from his sharing about the history and he brought it to life through his storytelling. I would highly recommend this tour with Rafael to anyone who’s keen to visit Avila and Segovia! So rich in history! 👍🏻

A wonderful trip, one I would recommend however, read up on Avila and Segovia before you go if you don't speak Spanish. Avila is a beautiful medieval town surrounded by a magnificent wall. Lunch is a tapas with a drink, the tapas was a small , two bite size piece of bread, a two bite size of sausage and a two bite piece of fried pork skin. You can order more at your own costs we then drove directly to Segovia. It is wonderful! You start out seeing the aquaducts then walk through from one side of the city to the other where you tour the fairytale looking castle.. we do not speak Spanish so it was very frustrating as the tour guide spoke about 75% Spanish and after a while we gave up asking he questions. After doing this tour and the yellow bus tour in Madrid we are not going to take any more tours as they do not speak enough English. We have a Rick Stevens book and did his walking tours and found them really enjoyable and informative. It's a shame as I love doing tours.

Despite starting an hour late (the bus got stuck on closed streets), the tour more then made up for it. The guide was super knowledgeable and had many stories and anecdotes to add. We had some free time which made the tour less regimented then you usually get from the big bus tours. But be prepared for a very long day and bring snacks!

This tour was our favorite day in Spain. Diego, our tour guide, set our expectations so high that no tour compared to the one we had with him as our guide. He is a walking encyclopedia- constantly pointing out different things around the cities, creating an engaging and intimate atmosphere, and speaking bilingually with such diligence. After the tour, I had learned & digested more about Spain than I ever did in school. The knowledge he shared is relevant, interesting, funny, and memorable. He is extremely personable, approachable, focused, active, attentive, and efficient. Each moment was guided by direction, purpose, and intention.
The monuments we visited were phenomenal in each city. We felt like we got the full experience- we saw & learned about everything the cities have to offer in the short period of time.
Our favorite part was walking through the cities listening to everything Diego said. He truly was the reason we had the best excursion ever!

Great sites and cities, worthy of our time and money. Stops were well timed and the itinerary was perfect. The bus audio system screeched and malfunctioned for the first 15 minutes out of Madrid. They finally figured it out.

German, our English-speaking guide was hard to hear and the audio faded in and out all day.
He either needs a new microphone or needs to figure out how to use it.

German did his job and was knowledgeable, but he lacked humor and had virtually no rapport with his customers. He is a "grade "C-" guide working on a Grade "A" tour. I think if Germain entered a different occupation both he and his customers would be happier!

Our guide was very knowledgeable and full of enthusiasm. She kept referring to us as "Family" to call the group which we felt was genuine throughout the trip towards Avila and Segovia. The trip was worth every second and I wish we had more time to witness the Market of the Three Cultures which happens around this time in Sept...I'd definitely pay extra to spend more time there.

Rafael was an excellent tour guide that was very knowledgeable and well versed about the Avila and Segovia. From the beginning of the tour where we met, to leaving Madrid, He gave a detailed summary of what were doing for the day and pointed out and explained many attractions of Madrid, Avila and Segovia. He is very approachable with anything you did not understand and anything you may have needed on the tour. He was a class act and definitely recommend having him as your tour guide and going on this tour to see and hear some of the great history and cities of Spain.

Wonderful day trip! The weather did not cooperate the day I went (it rained the entire time, windy, and cold), but it was still beautiful. Our tour guide was great and kept everyone in good spirits despite the weather. Our tour guide was so knowledgable. We walked a lot, saw so many beautiful things, and got a bit of time on our own to shop and eat. Highly, highly recommend!

Rafa was a fabulous guide because of his knowledge and wonderful way of weaving history into the sites at Segovia and Avilato bring them alive. The tour is well organized to allow time for all guests to enjoy the experience comfortably but keep all engaged and interested.Definitely recommend this tour !

My wife and I enjoyed a very nice day touring Avila and Segovia. Bus was comfortable and boarding went fine from the downtown office adjacent to the Palacio Real. We went with the English speaking guide who was expertly knowledgeable on the main parts of both sites. Be prepared for a good amount of walking and step climbing but nothing too strenuous. We went for the gastronomic feast in Segovia which was a fair representation of the local cuisine. Probably could have done this better seeing each city independently renting a car or taking a train (more expensive) but all in all a very worthwhile day.

Wonderful day trip from Madrid led by Arantxa featuring the highlights of Avila and Segovia. Avila is incredibly charming and not to be missed. Lunch in Avila was very good. The aqueducts of Segovia did not disappoint. Arantxa did a fantastic job of walking of through the highlights of each city without feeling rushed.

The Avila and Segovia tour is great! I especially loved Segovia. It’s a wonderful way to spend a day outside of Madrid. Definitely do it!

Our tour guide, Irene, was excellent too. She was entertaining, informative and always smiling. She knew so much about both cities. She brought their history and all the places we saw to life with the stories she told.

It’s colder in Segovia and Avila because of their elevation so grab your jacket and do this tour!

Renee was awesome ! But be prepared it's a 10KM walk in total. The 2 cities we're really enjoyable with a little free time to explore (Around 1h in each city after the walking tour). Only downside, it's a 60 passagers bus, so it is not near a little group. But worth it.

Booked this tour for September 23rd, paid in advance on August 1st and received confirmation the same day. Thought nothing else of it until receiving a phone message a month and a half later, while I was in Madrid and one day before the actual tour date, advising that there was a possibility the tour was to be cancelled because of some company conflicts. I called the number and spoke with someone who offered a different tour to Toledo on the day in question or if I could go on two other alternate dates. Not wanting to appear intractable, I explained that if I had wanted to go to Toledo or if I had wanted to use a different date for this particular tour I would have done so at the time of the original booking. It is not unreasonable to assume travelers will plan around dates to schedule other activities, especially when those dates were reserved and accounted for a month and a half earlier. Since they were not yet willing to give up on the booking, I asked that a text message be sent as soon as possible to let me know and, later that evening, received said message along with cancellation and refund instructions. As these things can happen (though oddly there were three such cancellations in different cities for different venues using different companies on this 3 week trip), I offer this only as an informational note to those planning ahead.

Rafa and Oscar were excellent tour guides. It was a nicely paced walk-tour through the cities of Avila and Segovia. Ample time to take pictures with city highlights and to quickly look through the small shops. Just be wary of siesta time when shops are closed and bring hat, umbrella and plenty of water to protect yourself from the heat. For the included lunch in Avila, I had a beer plus a tapa plate. Yes it is small, so bigger lunch can be purchased for extra at the same restaurant. Another option, depending on extra time, is to walk back inside the gate and look for the main square with restaurants. Also, the bus was new but no USB ports for charging so bring a portable. There are plenty of photo ops at every corner and more than likely to take pictures with a cellphone. All in all it was very informative and fun experience that anyone can enjoy.

I thoroughly enjoyed this trip which took us 90 minutes north of Madrid. The tour guide (Oscar) was funny and kind and made the experience very enjoyable. We visited different cathedrals, castles and churches around Segovia and Avila. They had different tours for people who speak different languages and the translations were perfect. They give you time to take pictures and tell you facts about the history of the place you are in. The whole tour was well timed, allowing for a spot of lunch and a late afternoon return to Madrid.

One of the best - if not the best - guided tours my wife and I have been on. Raphael was an incredibly knowledgeable and engaging guide, walking us through the rich history of both Avila and Segovia through interesting storytelling and humor. Would highly recommend.

This tour is an all day affair, starting at 9 am in the bus ride to Avila and not ending until 5:15 in Segovia, so bring your walking shoes but leave your impatience at home! There was plenty of time to do your own thing but the pace was perfectly timed to keep the tour moving forward.

Great tour. Recommend it. A little to fast. But really good. Great picture opportunities. They took us to Segovia where we went inside the castle and were standing in the room where Christopher Columbus was interviewed by the quien. And we saw the Roman aqueducts which took great pictures. Also took us to Avila where we learned great history. Had lunch and took amazing pictures.

This trip was an awesome experience for a day trip outside of Madrid. Rafael was an awesome english speaking tour guide who knew a lot of facts and history that I have never heard before. I enjoyed the length of each tour as it was not super extensive but long enough to see everything and hear the stories behind it. Additionally, I enjoyed having free time to grab a water or snack. The only thing I would note is that there are 2 packages and 1 does not include the tours of the buildings, this was an additional 27€ Which you can pay for during the trip or choose to have free time during this. Overall an amazing experience and happy I came across this trip.

My first time on a tour like this, going far away from the city (at least an hour to each stop) and seeing historical sites. It did not disappoint, and my jaw dropped several times when I first laid eyes on these giant cultural landmarks. Believe me, you can see as many photos as you want, but seeing them in real life was truly amazing. They provide everyone with audio receivers so you can hear what the guide is saying (as long as you stay relatively close), and our guide took care to go over his tour notes in both Spanish and English. My only small complaint is that he was also giving us some commentary on the bus between stops, but the bus speakers weren't loud enough to overcome the ambient bus noise, so I didn't really catch much of what he was saying. No worries, because the bus ride was so comfortable I took a quick nap on each ride anyway!

Very informative and exciting! We spent the perfect amount of time in each city and learned a bit about history, architecture, and culture. It was just the right amount of information. Rafa, our tour guide, was very positive and obviously loves his job! Highly recommend this tour!!!

If you love culture, history & religious beliefs, this is for you. Plenty of walking & comfortable shoes are a must. Buses were comfortable & we had plenty of time to explore on our own at both sites. Our guide was Raphael & he kept the narration interesting with lots of background information.
The lunch break was amazing with many choices to dine. We had time to take a little nap after lunch on our way to Segovia. This part of the tour was interesting too. The views are absolutely gorgeous.
If you’ve got knee problems & can’t climb hills, this is not for you. A full days trip & it is worth it

It was a good tour, very pretty places. Something to note, this tour is combined with the 70€ tour as well and they will leave you a couple times and go into a couple places that are not included with this one, but I honestly didn’t feel like I was missing out on much, we had to buy a separate ticket to get into the cathedral but it was only 3 €, 5 € if you want a tour up the clock tower, and the 70€ tour doesn’t even go up there, but you will have time because they will go into a castle thats not included. I felt like we were able to do equally cool stuff and we saved like 30€.

Rafael & Ileana were both great guides. The trip definitely did not seem like 9 hours. Rafael was very knowledgeable about the history and we learned a lot. I personally wouldn’t do Avila, Segovia AND Toledo in 1 day as Avila & Segovia were certainly more than enough for us adults. We did have our 3 teenagers on the tour with us and they very much enjoyed the tour. I would highly recommend this tour. The one con was that the wi-fi on the bus wasn’t working as they mentioned they were changing carriers for that but the AC was & that was priceless considering we visited during the hottest month of August.

We absolutely loved the full day tour of Avila and Segovia. We appreciated how much ground the tour covered and found the wall of Avila and aqueduct of Segovia incredible! We also did the full day tour of Toledo with Fun and Tickets and thought this tour was SO much better! If you had to do one tour definitely do this one. The Toledo tour didn’t cover as much as this tour but was more expensive—definitely could cover just as much by taking the 25 minute high speed train from Madrid yourself if wanting to tour Toledo. We also appreciated the tapas and drink included in the tour price to Avila and Segovia and loved being able to visit so many sites in both cities.

This was a great way to make the most of my time in Madrid and see Avila and Segovia. Rafael was a very informative and interesting tour guide. He was very knowledgeable but kept things humourous throughout. I saw and learned far more than I would have done on my own. Even the bus rides were interesting filled with facts as we drove and even time for a much needed midday siesta. You walk around able to hear great with little earphones in a receiver but have the flexibility to break off as desired. The included tapas and drink were at the perfect time. Would definitely book again. Grateful for a wonderful day!

Beatriz, or Betty as I gladly got to know her was such an affable, well-versed and lovely guide. She made the experience so easy to follow along with and translated in a fluent manner in both English and Spanish. She was a very sweet person and so easy to speak to. Thank you for the lovely experience!

We went to all the major sites in both Ávila then Segovia with ample amounts of stops in both sites. Our group was a particularly nice bunch and everyone generally stuck together as well as made it very comfortable for one another.

Great way to see the two cities!

We were a group of 4, including a 4 year old and a 65 year old. The tour did feel quick, and we brought up the rear at times, but we had enough time for snacks (slice of egg tortilla at two stops, Avila and Segovia), that kept us going! We could push the stroller easy enough, but too many small children in a group may prove challenging. There are a number of stairs to reach restrooms - which is true whether you visit these sites by tour or solo.
By the end of the day we had done a fair amount of walking but seen some beautiful sights.

Our guide, Irene, was kind and both guides stopped to make sure no one was left behind as we went from place to place.

Though our feet were achey by the end, we would have welcomed an addition 30 mins to shop some of the street vendors and shops to grab a souvenir as we passed. There were many interesting shops in Segovia in particular.

A short time was given for photo ops which could also be used to grab a small desert or coffee at the end of the Segovia walking tour. We did both those things! But it isn’t enough to also buy a souvenir from a shop. Either way, the tour was an easy way to see highlights of these two cities. Would recommend!

We visited picturesque cities, enjoyed short rests in the comfortable and AC bus, and had a great day on the tour.

We had a fabulous time on our trip to Avila and Segovia! Raphael was a fun, knowledgeable, and attentive guide, and he made sure that everyone felt taken care of and included throughout the whole tour. We did quite a bit of walking (it is a walking tour), but it wasn’t too strenuous. The ancient walls, cathedrals, palace, and aqueduct were simply breathtaking. You will take many Instagram-worthy pictures! I would highly recommend this tour to anyone who’d like to enjoy some beautiful sights and fascinating history. It was definitely money and time well-spent!

Not a history or religion buff but was floored by the experience. The cathedrals and cities are well worth the visit. Context provided by the guide was what made it really worthwhile/ sold me the experience beyond looking at some nice looking buildings.

Our guide did a great job of keeping our large group moving, while also taking time to answer all our questions and give in depth explanations and background for all that we saw. He spoke fairly good English, although we sometimes found his pronunciation and word choice a little hard to follow. We especially enjoyed the beautiful cathedral in Segovia and could have spent more time there. Members of the group were free to spend time as they chose as long as we were all at the departure point on time. Overall, a very enjoyable day.

Overall my husband and I were happy with the tour. I would say Avila looked kind of cool from the outside before you enter the walls, but once inside the walls it’s nothing impressive but we still enjoyed the tour. Definitely the highlight of the trip was Segovia, and the Roman Aqueduct was outstanding and the pictures are nothing compared to how it looks in person.

The tour itself was very good with chatty explanations and at a well-paced walking speed, but the drive from the meeting place to the 1st destination. We were divided into a smaller groups of maybe 12 people, and our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and he was very good.

Avila took about 90 minutes, to the 2nd destination Segovia another 80 minutes, and another 40 minutes to return to the original meeting place, so we spent a total of sitting on the bus for over 3 hours and 30 minutes, and this was not explained on the website.

Bus is overall comfy, but the seats recline so much, so if the person in front of you recline back all the way, expect that you will have no leg room and that person’s head will be only a few inches away from you. This was the case for me, and I couldn’t even get up was how little/no room I had, so I had to ask the lady to put her chair in an upright position so I could get up. Most people slept on the way there and back.

One main negative thing was at the very end, one of the tour guides (not the one we had in our smaller group) reminded us to tip them and he announced it over the bus microphone 2-3 times, and this was very weird since tipping is not customary in Spain nor will any business ask for it because people are paid appropriately since tips are not expected. We did a number of other tours in Spain, and that did not happen with other tours.

My favorite part of the experience was the ability to visit Avila and Segovia from Madrid in one day and learning the history of both places from our tour guide Rafael. Rafael had a deep knowledge of Spanish history, geography, and art history. He made learning so fun! He was professional, friendly and easy to understand. I’ve been in tours in the past where I had trouble understanding the tour guide due to his/her heavy accent. Not the case with a Rafael. His English was great and I was able to understand him. He is well traveled and also speaks Italian and German.

Take this tour if you want to cover a lot of sites in one day, but not if you want to take pictures. Stops at each site are short and there is no dedicated time for taking pictures in most places.

Apart from that, the tour commentary was good, the pre-selected restaurant for lunch is great and some time is allowed to enter souvenir shops.

Irene was very knowledgeable, courteous, and interactive throughout the experience. The sights were absolutely breathtaking and is a must if you’re visiting Madrid. The coach bus was very comfortable and the drive was fantastic, thanks to the driver of course. Don’t let the bad reviews fool you.. there were certain persons we went with that didn’t follow directions, were very rude to others (including the guide), I’m sure there are the same ones leading bad reviews or anything other than 5 stars. You do have the option of going on your own walking through the cities but they will tell you a meeting point that you must be at and by a certain time to make it to the next stop on the coach. Again, absolute must if you’re in Madrid and have the day to spend. Thank you very much Irene!!

Raphael was excellent!

I went into this tour looking very forward to Segovia and not knowing anything about Avila. Turned out that Avila was amazing! I knew nothing about it up front but Raphael made it so interesting and I would be hard pressed to choose my favorite location. I was amazed to find that Avila was first founded 4500 years ago!

The most amazing part of Segovia is the 2000 year old roman aqueduct! Initially the tour stayed at the bottom of the aqueduct. I asked if we were going to the top, but was told typically no. However, Raphael was flexible and asked the rest of the tour if they wanted to take the stairs. We all ended up taking the stairs to the top and it was well worth it!

I highly recommend taking this tour.

This was a great way to see both Avila and Segovia. The bus was new, comfortable and clean. Our guide Rafa was great! He was very knowledgeable and was responsive to questions. He injected humor into the presentation and handled the dual language portions of the tour very well. For the walking portions of the tour we were split into a Spanish group and an English group. Despite the large size of the English group, everything went smoothly. We covered a lot of ground and didn’t have much time on our own, but I expected this and appreciated a professional tour that took care of all the details.

My 17 yr old daughter and I really enjoyed the tour and length of time in each city. Going with a tour cut out all of the planning and figuring out the key aspects of each city. Our tour guide was thorough and passionate and we had a bit of free time too. Thanks Maria!

The guide Javier was very nice and thorough. I thought it was very well planned to be able to see all the important spots in the cities. I would have liked to buy all the entrances in advance but we had cash so we were able to pay the entrances which I didn’t see as an option when I purchased. They were worth the visit, so I’d definitely recommend entering the cathedrals and palace or Alcazar. I would have run into the cathedral of Avila and bought a yema of Avila if I went again. It was unusually cold and rainy which was a 20 degree Fahrenheit difference from Madrid, so check the weather!! We had to buy sweatshirts! I would have appreciated the explanations out of the rain but it’s difficult with a large group. We brought iPads on the bus which we left while we were on the tour. We should have brought phone chargers. All in all a great experience!

Madrid ah Madrid
This city was awesome, I was only there for 3 days,but it was wonderful experience. The one thing that was outstanding was the Bullfight at the Madrid arena, I was really
happy I did it, seeing that in person was spectacular, the Matadors had a lot of class, great moves. If in Madrid go and see it.
Then we went to the Prada museum the next day and as it goes it was great like most of the museums in Europe.
As for food, try the local restaurant's, I didn't have a bad meal while I was there. And the beer was great.
So much to see in Madrid I wish I had more time.
Will on my way to see more of Spain's other great citys.
Happy and safe travels. RGB.

Well organized trip with enough free time in it to take photos and do some personal exploration. I usually avoid large tours but this one conveniently got me to all the locations I wanted to visit with minimal fuss. So it is worth it along for the organized transport and entries. The guides were quite knowledgeable as well. I also joined the Spanish speaking group instead of the English as it was smaller and more peaceful, about 1/3-1/4 of the bus people wise. I met another solo traveler and we hung out the rest of the day once we returned to Madrid so that was also fabulous!

The bus service to Avila and Segovia was comfortable and convenient. Not having to deal with renting a car was a plus. However, to call this a bilingual tour was a major stretch. Our guide, Paco, was nice enough but his English sounded just like Spanish and his speech was mostly Spanish with a few English words thrown in once in a while. We tried intently to figure out what he was saying but it just gave us a headache. It would have been much better to have a pre-recorded tape in English with information available at each interest point. Another thing: if you go, be sure to show up early. We arrived 7 minutes before departure time and he was already leaving for the bus without us. We were lucky to have caught them. The cities themselves were amazing and definitely worth the trip. Segovia has an amazingly well preserved section of Roman Aqueduct that is breathtaking. The castle in Segovia is also a must - see.

Was just what we hoped for. A wonderful day and fantastic experiences. Oscar was all you could ever hope for in a guide. Made the day educational and fun. He was very fluent in both Spanish and English balancing both very well for our bilingual group. Very easy to hear and understand. Avila and Segovia exceeded our expectations! Great tour!

Such a good tour! We did another tour from the same company to Toledo yesterday and this one was SO much better. Pilar was very knowledgeable and switched between English and Spanish seamlessly. It was super nice to nap on the bus between destinations and there was a good amount of time spent in both locations. Thank you!!

Really nice tour with a great tour guide. You will see a lot of both places and will get a lot of information about the history. Wear good shoos because you will walk a lot.

In Ávila you can enjoy a nice lunch in a restaurant of your choise or walk around a bit on your own before heading to Segovia.

Overall experience was good, we enjoyed traveling to Avila and Segovia for the day. This trip is an all day trip which was great. The bus was very nice and clean, very comfortable for the trip. The walking trip envolves a lot of walking, roughly 12,000 steps with quite of stairs and many incline and declines. Overall was a great experience and would recommend. The only complaint that I had was the radios used during the tours did not have good range. Once the guide reached more that 10 feet the radio would cut out. Other than that it was great.

Raphael was very knowledgeable — I loved hearing his stories and insights. Raphael had a very lively personality and enjoyed joking around with us. He made the experience extremely enjoyable and cared about every individual’s experience. He gave us a perfect mixture of sightseeing, time for meals, and time to explore on our own. If you come to Madrid, this is a great day trip that is definitely worth your time. The air-conditioned bus was also very nice to have after a long day of walking in the heat. Look out for territorial Karen’s on the tour though — some 40 year old women need to learn how to not fight with 19 year olds. Please be mature when on this tour, thank you.

Our guide Rafael did an excellent job. The tour has over 70 participants & he handled it very well. He gave us a clear presentation in all places of interest. Robert gave me clear instructions when contact their office.
Recommend Fun & Tickets Tour.

Tour guide was absolutely lovely, she was amazing.
HOWEVER the earphones are cheap and nasty they hert your ears.
The head sets kept cutting out so you only hear 60% of the tour, you basically have to walk next to your tour guide to hear all information.
Food was poor, you only get 1 little slice of egg tortillas definitely not enough food for the length of the tour or price of the tour.

Overall cities were beautiful and worth the visit

Irene was great! She had very good knowledge of both Avila and Segovia. She also gave us ample free time for potty breaks and to get drinks and snacks. We did not feel rushed. Overall it was a great day spent with her!

This is advertised as a family tour but is anything but that. The tour is rushed and you can barely stop to go to the bathroom. The tour guides didn’t speak very good English and our tour guide German didn’t show the proper reverence and respect in the Catholic Churches and sites.
We had an issue and contacted the office and Antonia was extremely rude hanging up on us.
The bust is advertised as having AC and it didn’t work. The second level was so hot kids were getting overheated and getting sick and one of the tour guides left the family that had the kid sick. Please save your money and take the train to Segovia yourself or find another company. We have traveled to a lot of countries in Europe and taken many tours but this was the worst. Segovia and Avila are beautiful but the service of this company was terrible.

We were staying in Madrid but wanted to get out and see some of the surrounding towns. This trip was a great pace, lots of history and sightseeing with amazing tour guides. I highly recommend this tour to anyone who has a free day and wants to get more out of their trip to Spain. We were back in the city in plenty of time for dinner and an evening out.

Arantxa was excellent! Very knowledgeable and personable. Segovia and Avila are both beautiful places to visit and well worth a day trip. Be prepared to walk a lot (although some guests with mobility issues got taxis on certain sections- so that is an option). The meeting point at the start of the day was a bit confusing as there were two different groups meeting and no signage. Also the tapas lunch was laughable, I recommend getting your free drink then having lunch elsewhere. Overall a lovely day!

Seeing the old walled city, and the environment of Teresa of Avila, and then the Roman aqueduct in Segovia were all highlights. Maria, our English language guide, was expert and informative, as well as good at keeping us on time. This trip was more than worth the price, and my husband and I found ourselves wishing we had spent a few days in Segovia. A great day. Wear cushioned shoes and bring water. You have a few stops, but it can be hot in summer. The coach was comfortable and the AC very good.

Ten days were cut off my trip to Spain and this tour gave me back a day. Not only that, but the guide was excellent. She knew her topic, answered questions easily and kept us moving at a steady pace that did not seem rushed. I learned more and learned it quicker than if I had done both cities on my own. And I didn't have to navigate trains and buses!

The 5 star reviews are very misleading. First of all,
How do you get so many people on a bus that has malfunctioning a/c? It was a sauna in there, come on. I complained twice and nothing. So inconsiderate and ruthless. Some of us were sweating and others using paper fans.

Second, The tour felt so rushed, I could barely stop to take pictures without losing connection from the device which then meant I couldn’t hear what the tour guide was saying and then when I finally got audio back, I was completely lost.

Third, The restaurant the staff took us to in Avila was horrible. The service was terrible and the waitress was so so rude.

I am so dissapointed by this tour, it didn’t meet my expectations. Sadly, This is probably the worst tour I’ve ever been on.

31st of October was really cold in Ávila and Segovia, but it became better after walk with Irene. The pace was good, but I’m not the person that take a photo at every corner. Really enjoyed Ávila and Segovia, you could see beautiful places, and since I’m personally from Eastern Europe it’s really different in the matter of scenery. The guide was competent, bus was comfortable, provided food was ok-ish, and the radio receivers was great, together with my wife we heard everything. We also liked the English of the guide, we are not natives, but it was good enough to understand all the stories, curiosities and jokes. Thanks for a great trip.

Great full day experience. I never felt rushed and had a fantastic guide, Irene, who kept it interesting and explained everything we saw. It was a large group but split into two, English and Spanish. Only thing is to make sure you stay close to your guide or the connection may start to cut out and you won’t hear as well. Overall great tour and definitely recommend!

I purchased a ticket for this day trip and was notified by them that the trip had been moved a day. They offered a refund but ignored all of my messages when I tried to get it. Be careful with this one. This app won’t let me show screenshots of my text exchange with them.

Took a full-day bus tour to Avila and Segovia (from Madrid) with Raffa and Betty. Both guides were very good at their job, super knowledgeable, and extremely friendly.

Buses left on time, but did not run air conditioning very well and it was extremely uncomfortable for a couple long bus rides throughout the day.

Have been on a few group tours now and this was one of the best. Thanks!
-Elisa & Javi Guerra (from US -Arizona).

There should have been an hour added to this tour easily; we were super rushed, had no time for pictures, no time/decent place provided for lunch. It was super hectic and didn’t have time to enjoy the scenes at all. Maria tour guide was awesome, but German was ineffective - his English was not audible and the microphone he was using not working!

The best thing about the tour hands down were the tour guides, Raphael & Irene. They deserve more than 5 stars. It was great that the tour was broken down to English & Spanish speaking group. The guides were informative, helpful & friendly. The tour was a long day but a nice thing to do while visiting Madrid. DO NOT rely on the Tapas and drink for your meal! It is a small piece of egg. Be prepared to buy lunch and or breakfast. There are plenty of opportunities to do so and to get drinks along the way. The tour description contains 2 material misrepresentations, 1) THERE WAS NO WIFI ON THE BUS; If you bring charger make sure it had USB port to plug into the bus; 2) The tour is NOT limited to 35 people it was a full coach bus and probably double the amount. Overall, it was a nice day to kill the day. It was Hot and the guides were absolutely wonderful

Good tour, pretty places and lots of information. Enough free time to get some food and drinks. I didn’t buy the monuments in the cities but I’m not sure it would’ve been much different if I did. I still got to see some super cool views. Went up to the top of the cathedral tower in Segovia for only 5€ while the rest of the group went into the castle. It was incredible and I don’t regret it at all.

This excursion was booked as a birthday treat whilst
I was away with my friend, holidaying in Madrid.
The tour guide, Irene was excellent! Her English was very good and I over heard she speaks another 2 languages, as well as her mother tongue, Spanish! Avila was beautiful and Irene’s knowledge was great. Before heading off to Segovia we stopped off for an appetiser, which despite being the traditional tortilla I thought it would be bigger but that being said we ate it quickly, drank a lovely glass of sangria and then headed off to the coach after exploring for 30 minutes or so. Segovia is like no other town I have been to, it was amazing. You are pre-warned that is a lot of walking, 20,000+ steps later we arrived back to Madrid at 6pm. A long but lovely day. Thank you Irene!

A very good, if quite rushed, overview of the two cities. The weather was perfect and we were shown the major sights, although there was a feeling of being rushed around a little. I wouldn't have minded a longer day if it meant more free time in each place but the "free time" was no more than 45 mins in each place, which just isn't enough to do anything. Lunch was not really factored in, and had to be tapas more than an actual meal, and this took place during the free time in Avila. The tour should start earlier and finish later so we can explore a little more, and relax and enjoy!

Comfortable bus ride and you get to see a lot of sites in both towns. Guides are very knowledgeable and our guide in particular encouraged questions and discussion. Only downside was the size of the group - we were 60 people on the bus but at least spilt into two groups of 30 for touring.

A good tour. The guide was knowledgeable and humorous. My wife and I really enjoyed the aqueduct and castle at Segovia. Avila was small and quaint and cute. Two negatives, the tapas lunch is tiny so bring something along for lunch or be prepared to order from the menu, and our bus had no A/C (mechanical problem)so we roasted for much of the round trip.

The tour guide was excellent and the bus was comfortable. The biggest complaint is that it was difficult to hear the tour guide due to the large group size. The tour guide used a radio and we had earbuds. However, the tour guide walked fast and if you didn't stay extremely close to the tour guide then the radio didn't work and you could not hear. There were too many people for everyone to be close enough to the guide.

Rafael was friendly and helpful, knew a lot of history.

Both cities Avila and Segovia were beautiful with rich history but requires quite a bit of uphill walking around town.

wireless receivers with earphones were provided for everyone
Although the group was a little too big at 29 people per guide (our bus had over 60 peeps)

If you like taking photos of amazing landscapes, castles, cathedrals and Roman aqueducts.. while learning.. this is is it. Arantxa was our guide and she’s bilingual (English/Spanish) and I accidentally just went into the bus without checking-in but she found us stowing away 😂.. but she instantly helped us, called the other bus to report they found us and no longer MIA.

She was a delight, and funny, personable.

The tour itself is wonderful- we went to Segovia and Avila— ate in Avila. I would definitely recommend this tour.

Having visited Toledo before this trip, I would say Avila and Segovia are must-go destinations. The architecture is interesting and the scenery is breathtaking. Oscar, our English speaking guide, was very detailed in his explanations of the various notable sights, architecture and history. Even though the tour group was quite huge, they split us up into English and Spanish speaking groups, making it a lot more manageable. The aqueduct in Segovia is the highlight for me.

Excellent tour that hits the highlights of these 2 historic cities. I was not disappointed in the last minute tour choice and I highly recommend it for anyone wanting to hit the highlights. It will definitely make you want to go back to each city to stay and explore. Information was very well provided and our guide team of Oscar, Rafael aka Rafa & Latecia did an amazing job!

Great tour! Great tour guide (Irene) and excellent driver. Some more free time would be so nice at each location. Tour guide can take more time to complete explanations - would start a story but not finish it clearly, or would move on to another story. All-in-all, a great tour experience at two amazing destinations. Highly recommended!

The trip is a cultural journey in few historical places of Spain. The objectives have deep roots into the troubled history of the region, showing also advanced cultural developments during she's. Our guide, Rafael, was an educated, well socket person with vast knowledge of arts and history. The journey was a big pleasure which should not be missed by anyone visiting Madrid.

This was an amazing tour to Avila and Segovia. The sights were amazing; very gothic, artistic, and takes you back to the Middle Ages. Our tour guide Christina was very informative and equally spoke in Spanish and English so both groups of people could understand the tour. The bus was relatively comfortable and even though we were out walking all day, it was exciting to walk around and explore the towns. This tour is a nice day trip to get away from the hectic city of Madrid. I highly recommend!

It was a great trip! We were a little surprise by all the people since the description said max 15. But, there were only 2 seats left on a big bus and people were struggling trying to find seats. What they didn’t tell you is that the other half of the bus is a Spanish tour. But, even with my English tour, I counted more than 15. But, the rest of the trip was great. Our tour guide was good and both cities are worth visiting. They are quite beautiful! Just really wish they kept to the 15 max.

My tour was led by Irene Diaz Tornero - she was an awesome tour guide and made the whole day of experience way better than anticipated. The tour takes us to Avila and Segovia via bus. Once at the location, Irene offered English-audio tour guide about historical and cultural context of these places. Avila and Segovia have very picturesque locations with breathtaking views. Highly recommended!

The tour was great, but that was due in large part to our phenomenal tour guide, Rafa. Rafa was knowledgeable, patient, funny, and engaging. He is a natural tour guide as he provides the perfect balance of guided narration while still allowing individuals the time to explore on their own. His English and historical knowledge are impeccable and he is more than happy to answer any and all questions.

Our tour with Rafa and Hernan was spectacular! Ávila and Segovia are two beautiful cities worth seeing if you are staying in Madrid for a few days. We went in late May and it was warm but very comfortable. The tour guides made us feel very laid back on our excursion, and the bus was very comfortable. 5 stars!!

Wonderful trip! It departed promptly and the bus was very comfortable with a toilet. Our guide Rafa was very attentive with ensuring our comfort whilst also being very passionate and entertaining about the history of the cities we visited - I learnt a lot. The bus journey between the 2 cities stopped it feeling like too longer day, and there was time at the end of each tour to purchase souvenirs and food.

An outstanding trip ! Both Avila and Segovia were lovely and we had a fantastic day, not least due to the truly exceptional guide we had, Rafa. Courteous, considerate, informative, helpful and entertaining throughout he made sure everyone was happy and enjoyed the tour. Comfortable bus and good complimentary headphone sets to hear the guide whilst walking around. The walls of Avila and the aquaduct at Segovia are amazing. Throroughly recommended !

The best part was the easiness of getting to the bus and being able to visit two sites without worrying about public transportation. Also with a guide you can get a lot of unique info that would be unknown without adequate research. I think one day for these two sites is just enough. I will say that the time went by very quick (total of 10 hours including 3 hours of total bus ride times). You will also be walking around 10 kilometers. Finally Irene was our guide and she did a nice job explaining the history without rushing and she also has a good sense of humor, thank you Irene and Fun and Tickets for making our trip memorable.

The overall experience has been great. Pila is very professional and took good care of everyone. We got to learn many background and small stories that we wouldn't know by exploring the cities on our own. It's a big group of 60 people and they divided them into two smaller groups with one guide each (English group and Spanish group). This improved the eficiency significantly. The audio guide they distributed to everyone was also very helpful. My only minor comment is lack of WiFi on the bus as promised.

Irene was our tour guide and she was excellent. Very knowledgeable about historical events and locations, even able to answer questions the crowd had outside of her prepared tour. Our favorite place was Segovia because of the more eventful tour exploring the castle and walking around the beautiful town.

Great trip, learned a lot with great photo opportunities. We were provided little radios to listen to the tour guide live time with headphones (all provided). Ample time to shop around on the tour and eat.

My first tour with Arantxa was a full day tour to Avila and Segovia. What a breathtaking views on the way to Segovia at Avila. I immediately took a selfie with Murallas of the Avila blackened me. We slow proceeded to a higher altitude and eventually reach Segovia. The ancient Roman aqueduct de Segovia was the highlight for me. The Alcazar of Segovia was a nice touch, however, and quite unfortunately my iPhone ran out of juice and I recommend taking a battery bank with you. I hiked and walk a total of 9.4 kilometers. Great tour and the opportunity to visit Avila and Segovia definitely should not be missed.

Great tour!
Avila & Segovia were the best part of our trip to Madrid.
The sights were spectacular.
Only suggestions for improvement would be for a guide that was easier to understand and more time in Segovia at the end of the tour to get some food and shopping.

I highly recommend this trip. My boyfriend and I had a wonderful time seeing the sites. The schedule for this trip allocates the perfect amount of time needed to see each site and freely grab coffee/quick breakfast in the morning, lunch of choosing, and even do some shopping if you like. Our guide Raphael was knowledgeable, funny, kind, and kept the whole group engaged throughout the tour. Did I mention how nice the tour bus was.... Our bus was brand new, clean, and comfortable. This tour is great for all ages as the walking required was minimal enough. If elderly there are some stairs on different sites as can be expected at historic sites. Additionally, our longest walk required was roughly a 15-20 minute stroll. It was rather easy as there was plenty to see during the short walk and the guide continues to provide you with plenty of history. All in all, it was the perfect day we were looking for on our Spain vacation! Thank you so much, Raphael!
We managed to see a lot of things in short time. Minor items made me not enter a perfect score. The AC in beginning of journey (cold) and fast pace (but only way to be shown so many things.

From bus ride, which was comfortable and informative to both destination towns everything was exceptional.
Tour spans two towns, Avila and Segovia. In Avila a small tapas and drink of choice were offered..which was nice. The tour can be given in English or Spanish, and a receiver and headphones are offered so you can easily follow along with the tour guides instructions and lessons. Rafael, our guide was awesome, both informative and understanding when it came to questions and discussion. For us, this tour was fundamental in breaking a 7 day stretch in Madrid with something education and absolutely beautiful.
Well worth the $.

Very cool trip. We left on the bus at about 9am, and returned to Madrid at about 6pm, so if you wanted you could have one more thing planned for the evening potentially. Ávila and Segovia are about an hour drive from Madrid, and an hour drive from each other. You will see some beautiful walls, cathedrals, basilicas, and castles, both outside and inside. Tons of history lessons too; maybe bring a notepad! There is an included reservation for lunch but the meal is not paid for.

Good trip would certainly recommend. Not too tiring and very engaging. One tip: don’t eat at the restaurant where the guide stops in Avila for free drinks, as the food was not good for us. Instead take opportunity to find a good restaurant nearby.

Rafa is a good guide and takes time to answer your questions.

This is a full day trip (9.5 hours) with a lot of walking (approximately 10 km). Both Avila and Segovia are lovely cities with lots of rich history. Our guide, Oscar, was very knowledgeable about the history and culture of the area.

It was a great tour; however the groups a little too big and makes organization strained. There were moments that were confusing and I think a smaller group would be better an allow for more questions and conversation about sites. Unfortunatly, due to the length of the tour you also don't get to spend as much time at sites as I would have liked and I would have prefered to visit the cities individually instead. However, the sites were gorgeous and well worth the visit. If you are short on time, I would totally recomend the tour to see these beautiful places.

I booked a tour of Avila and Segovia and it was an excellent tour. The tour leader was friendly and very informative. In Avila, we were brought around to all of the important sites and we had some free time for lunch and independent exploration. In Segovia, we were brought on a walk of the must see historic locations and we were told of the history of each location. If I was going to see Avila and Segovia, I would book this tour, as the guides bring you to all the sites in one day, which would be difficult using public transport.

Raphael was an amazing guide, he was knowledgeable, funny, and really wanted to ensure people had a good time. Ávila and Segovia are beautiful and incredibly well preserved. After the main tours, Raphael allowed for free time for folks to walk around these beautiful cities which was a nice change from other tours I’ve been on. That said, there is quite a bit of walking involved in this tour, comfortable shoes are a must. Speaking of walking, both cities are part of the Camino de Santiago. If you are interested in doing the Camino, get a sneak peak at the kinds of cities you’ll be visiting. Overall, it was a great experienceI, I definitely recommend taking this tour.

I normally don’t take big tours, so I was not sure what to expect. Loved the information, the pace and our tour guide Rafa was really knowledgeable, funny and thoughtful. Would completely recommend to everyone who wants to see spectacular cities and learn about Spanish history.

We did this trip whilst staying in Madrid & thoroughly enjoyed it. It's a full day in an air conditioned coach with an English speaking guide.
You visit Avila first & have time for a coffee prior to a guided tour around the old walled town & then visit Segovia, where you have time for a complimentary drink & lunch before a guided tour of the castle & cathedral.
There is quite a bit of walking involved but at a sensible pace & our guide, who's name I unfortunately forget, was excellent, very informative & humorous.
Very enjoyable & good Vue for money.

A great way to experience the two towns. Tour guide that cater to the crowd and show their knowledge and care for the history of the towns. We enjoyed the not to hectic pace and suggest if you have your own personal earbuds with a stereo plug, your ears will thank you 👍

Great tour of two amazing cities. We probably were too ambitious on the length of the day, but that’s not our tour guides fault.

Rafael was great, very informative and knew his stuff with humor thrown in for good measure.

I was sick the day of the tour (a bad cold) and I tried to contact the operator numerous ways (phone calls, whattsapp, email, trip advisor message) to reschedule. I could not contact anyone. It is 2 days later and I am still waiting for someone to contact me, so instead of moving to a different date, I asked Trip advisor for a refund and was denied.

Rafa was extremely knowledgeable and made the tour super engaging. Solid amount of time in both cities. I would definitely recommend if you are looking to see some amazing archeological structures and get some great history.

Very nice tour - our bus was split in half for the walking tours, which was great! The tour was in English, our guide Oscar was very good, shared lots of great information about the cities and monuments. So much better than the Toledo tour (by the same company) that we did the day prior.

Only thing I wish was different was to spend less time in the churches in Avila to allow us to walk the wall without sacrificing lunch. I personally like Segovia a lot more, and feel it would be just as good if we skipped Avila and spent the whole day in Segovia instead.

Awesome trip to two cities. Lots of walking (10k ++ steps), very interesting historical information about both towns and the history of Spain. There were a couple of welcome breaks for coffee/meals and a chance for a quick rest up on the coach between towns. Make sure you get breakfast in first, you will need the energy! Bring water, no eating on the coach. The coach was clean and comfortable, the guide did a great job of making historical connections and filling in some interesting details you might not discover yourself on a self- guided tour.

I recommend this tour for everyone and especially to group of people who are into roman history. Our guide, Arantxa was very well aware about the history of the place and explained everything very thoroughly. She was never on hurry and gave time at everyplace and made sure that everyone is together all the time. I was with my 11 months old son and she made sure that we were never forced to rush and the whole tour was quite pleasant. It was a day we'll spent.

I could tell that our tour guide Oscar was v enthusiastic and provided a good amount of historical information.
Unfortunately, his English was not v proficient and I had problems
understanding his explanations.
The tour would have been more
enjoyable is I could understand him better.
Wished the company had provided a more proficient English speaking guide.

Great experience! Rafael was a great tour guide and it was a very efficient tour. I tended to have a low opinion of bus tours before this, but Rafael kept it very entertaining and funny! I could understand other reviewers wanting more time in places, but I feel like if you wanted to spend a whole day at each place...you could just do so, lol. They're both wonderful sites so if you have time I'd recommend it, but this was a well-paced tour.

Our guide was outstanding explaining the sites we were seeing and the history accompanying them. She moved effortlessly between Spanish and English. We were all pleased. The use of headsets to hear her was ideal. I could hear without crowding close and even better I could stray a bit to take pictures and still hear perfectly. It was a full but perfect day! We would go on any tour offered by them in the future.

We took the tour from Madrid going to Avila and Segovia. Our guide Rafa made sure we didn’t lack anything and were comfortable for the whole 9h of the trip. The cities themselves are wonders to be seen, very different from Madrid. I highly recommend Fun&Tickets if you want a detailed guided tour around or in Madrid.
Thanks for a great experience :-)

Irene and Rafael were awesome!! The tour was great, a lot of information was shared and they answered all questions. The views are breathtaking and the history is so rich. The bus was really good, had AC and USB charging. Downside, the Wi-Fi didn’t work. Overall a fantastic experience!

Really enjoyed this very well organised tour. Great to see all the main attractions with a very knowledgeable tour guide to give a background. Rafael is excellent at what he does, very friendly manner and made the experience very enjoyable. Good timings, maybe just 10 or 20mins extra in segovia but overall the free time was very well organised.

Day trip from Madrid to Avila and Segovia was great. Lots of walking, learning about history, and seeing so many beautiful things. Photo ops at every turn! German was an excellent guide and took his time to make sure we soaked in the total experience. My only complaint is the bus is not well air conditioned so the transit part was uncomfortably warm.

Had a great time visiting the cities of Segovia and Avila, our tour guide Arantxa was amazing, she was able to do the your in English and Spanish during the whole day whiteout making it tedious. I give them 5 stars. Thanks for a great day!

Both places visited were excellent. Pace was too slow times and too fast others. Lady guide in Segovia lost one of the group, because he wondered off on his own, and it delayed us leaving by 30 mins to find him, that aside, a well worth trip with stunning architecture and full of history.

Our favourite part of the trip was the Alcazar in Segovia (it is a gorgeous castle with a beautiful mix of architecture). Both cities of Avila and Segovia are splendid. The guide, Pilar, was very warm and sweet to the group and we felt comfortable asking questions and listening to the presented history.
We consider the trip was definitely worth it and we recommend it with our whole heart.

visited Avila and Segovia. tour was very informative and our guide was quite knowledgeable about history of both cities. tour was moderately paced and not rushed which gave us time to eat and enjoy time of our own. both cities are amazing and rich in history, architecture and natural beauty. strongly recommend the tour as it takes you away from the hustle and bustle of Madrid city.

Irene was an excellent tour guide! She gave only positive vibes and attitude the whole day, and was very entertaining. She was very patient with our big group and accommodated us when needed. Would recommend this tour with Irene for anyone!

Beautiful tour of Segovia and Avila. Highly recommended if you’re staying in Madrid for more than a week. Rich in history. Our tour guide Oscar was well versed in the history of both events and architecture of the churches, cathedrals. It was a privilege to visit birthplace of St Teresa of Avila.

our tour guide, irene, made the experience much better, making sure to always engage her audience. the tour was informative and there were always stops for water and good snacks. irene gave us the english tour and oscar gave the spanish tour and both were very good. views were pretty but very hot so make sure to come prepared for that.

This was a really great tour. Perfectly timed where you aren’t too rushed and very interesting and informative. Rafael and Maria we fabulous guides!
This is a guided tour with some “free” time. It was really well thought out.
Highly recommend!

This was a great, fun, awesome trip for the whole family! Oscar was a fantastic and very knowledgeable tour guide. He made sure to explain the most important spots and showed us picture-worthy moments.

However, we do have a few points of suggestion. This includes fixing the audio, as our guide’s voice would fade and have lots of static, thus leaving us to not hear information. Second, the tour’s information said that the tour bus is equipped with air conditioning and free wifi, but this was false information as both were not provided. Overall, thank you for a memorable trip!

I liked it a lot. The only suggestion is, it would be good to inform in advance how the weather would be in the places we are going to visit, so we come prepared for that. The rest of the tour was really good. Beautiful places and lot of history and know on the topics. Thanks!

The tours to two sites were outstanding. Our guides were exceptionally knowledgeable about the two towns, plus the sites that we visited. The bus was spotless and air conditioned. Our guide (Rafa - may not be the correct spelling) was extremely knowledgeable about Spanish history. Overall an outstanding tour.

The Staff was on time and very friendly. The tour guide; Pilar was very knowledgable and fun. The bus that took us to Avila and Segovia was very comfortable and clean. However at times we felt in a rush and barely had time for good pictures or buy Souvenirs. Everything is in a fast-forwards mode.

I applaud our tour guide Rafael for being a fantastic and patient tour guide. The trip is definitely worth the price, it has been a day full of wonders, tasty local food and interesting learnings. I enjoyed the method they used to communicate with the group via complimentary headphones and a receiver device, so you could even hear clearly what Rafael was telling about the monuments while falling a bit behind to take photos.
