The trip is versatile with many bathroom stops to suit everyone. Highly recommended!

We had a great time touring both Avila and Segovia. Our tour guide Erene gave us a thorough narration of the history behind all the monuments and cathedrals. She made it more interesting and was great at giving us few breaks when we really needed it. Thank you all so much!

I would definitely consider a trip to Segovia. I would even recommend you spend more than one day. If you decide to go, Fun and Tickets tour with Oscar was amazing. His breath of knowledge surpasses most any guide we have ever had - from Art to history to culture. Our double decker bus was clean and comfortable.

This tour to Avila and Segovia ran very smoothly. As expected, stops in each church, monument, etc. were brief and there wasn’t a lot of free time, but we saw everything in the two towns. We couldn’t have done it on our own in just one day. Expect a lot of walking and bring water! Our guide was Irene and she was great at explaining the history behind each place we visited. Irene made sure that nobody got behind and she had a great sense of humor. The bus ride was comfortable. We left at 9am and came back at 6:30pm. Despite the long day we really enjoyed the tour.

This tour was really an ace if you want to learn about the history of two cities in one day. It may seem a little rushed but it's worth it. The guide (I think his name was) Oscar was funny and insightful on all things concerning the history of Spain. Cracked jokes left and right. I would recommend.

Exceptionally knowledgeable guide (Raphael) extensive information given on all sites visited, as well as broader Spanish/world history. Incredibly interesting. Answered any questions thrown his way. The sites were all worth seeing, beautiful architecture and saturated in history, the aqueduct personally being the pinnacle.
Roughly 7km of waking involved so worth baring that in mind if that’s not up your street.
Would highly recommend!

I’m not usually a fan of bus tours, but it made more sense to take this tour than to try to use public transit or trains. The guide was very friendly and knowledgeable. Even though the weather was poor, we had a nice walk through the towns. Definitely recommend this if you are staying in Madrid for a few days

This day trip to Avila and Segovia is a must if you are visiting Madrid! The comfortable tour bus was roomy and cool and the guides were fantastic. Shout out to Irene and Jerman for keeping us on schedule and being so fun and knowledgeable about the history and art and architecture we explored in these amazing historic and rich cities. So glad we went on the tour. It was fantastic and beyond our expectations!!

One of the best group day tours I have ever been on! The tour guide was absolutely fantastic, enthusiastic, and entertaining. Her language switching between English and Spanish was so smooth and incredibly impressive. There’s was loads of great modern and historical information told and the locations were such sights to see. Our tour ran long, but only because everyone wanted to take photos.

I really enjoyed my full day tour in Avila and Segovia. Our tour guides were Rafa and Maria. But we were divided into two groups since we were more than 40 people on the bus. They were very helpful. In my group Rafa was assigned to us. He was very knowledgeable and informative. I recommend this trip especially for Solo traveler and Family.

We really enjoyed this tour and our tour guide Rafael was very good. He was very knowledgeable. The group was fairly large, so one of the guides spoke all in English and the other Spanish. This allowed us to save time and separate into two groups. We really enjoyed walking around both Avila and Segovia.

Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and kept us entertained. Also he encouraged us asking questions. The listening devise was excellent tool. The guide can just guide the tour w normal voice and listeners can spread out. We joined the experience.

Rafael was an awesome guide. He had a great passion for what he was showing us and a great style of telling us the history. A well paced tour with the right amount of walking that can be managed by everyone. Incredible history before your eyes.

The tour was well organized with clear meeting points at various stops. It was also well paced with enough time for us to take photos, rest and enjoy the 2 cities. Our guide Irene shared lots of information at each of the attractions with a good sense of humour.

We learned so much! Not only was Raphael knowledgeable about the sites and the history, but he also filled in Spanish and Muslim cultural tidbits along the way. We sincerely appreciated the fluent English and seamless entry to all the sites. This tour provided a fascinating cultural experience of Avila and Segovia that we could not have achieved on our own. Well done and thank you!!

The trip was really worth it! The cities were fascinating and picturesque, and our guide Irene was fantastic. She managed a large tour without issue and was very knowledgeable about the attractions. The pace was brisk but do-able. You don’t have a lot of extra time for shopping but that was understood in the description. Well worth the money.

We normally don't do tours like this but our trip to Avila and Segovia convinced me of this is a rewarding and valuable way to experience a foreign country. We had a great guide (Rafeal), learned lots, met a bunch of really nice fellow travelers and experienced some truly remarkable ancient wonders and historical sites first hand. Easily a highlight of our trip.

Seeing Avila and Segovia were wonderful. Our guide did a great job of keeping the group together and explaining the sights and history.

The bus transportation was comfortable and the wireless communication from the guide worked nicely .

We’ve had a fabulous day exploring Avila and Segovia , both beautifully stunning places to visit . Our tour guide Rafael was extremely knowledgable and lots of fun too so huge thank you to him . We’d highly recommend booking this trip , beautiful castles and stunning churches .

Great trip! Saw lots of great sights with a knowledgeable guide. The only issue is you are part of a very large group. The large group divided into three groups of 25 so initially there was a little confusion with the logistics of dealing with so many people. We would definitely do it again just be aware of what your signing up for.

It was a well organized trip to two cities in one day. It was a bit hard to hear things on the bus, and a bathroom wasn’t available on it. I felt like the tour was a bit hard to follow but it was maybe just our guide.

We are happy with our day tour. Rafael is a best singer guide I’ve ever met😂. He is very nice and helpful. Even though it rained a bit during the day, it cooled down the temperature and it was quite pleasant after the rain.

We were in Rafael’s group and he is friendly, knowledgeable and engaging. Both Avila and Segovia have historic sites and stories worth exploring. We loved the trip and highly recommend it if you are visiting Madrid for a day out of the hustle and bustle.

Let me start off saying the tour itself was done well. They keep you on schedule and take you to the places listed. BUT- I wouldn’t recommend going on this tour. If you’ve been to other old cities with cathedrals you aren’t missing out on skipping their entries. It’s freezing as it’s twice the altitude as Madrid. You don’t have time to explore (they give you 30 minutes but with walking back to the shops you have no time). You don’t get to walk down to see the alcazar from the front which is what is scenic. Don’t waste an entire day you could be exploring Madrid. OR I would suggest traveling to Segovia on your own and skip Avila all together. There were a few on our bus that used the transport but didn’t do the entry into places and that looked more enjoyable than our tour.

What beautiful cities! Avila and Segovia day was full of history and beauty. Our guide, Rafael, spoke good English and was quite impressive with his knowledge of history. Bus was not as modern as the one we took to Toledo (no usb chargers) - minor negative compared to the entire trip.

Had an amazing time with the tour group and the company. We visited Segovia and Avila. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and provided plenty of information on the tour. If you get him you will be lucky. We did a full day tour and he was polite and explained everything well. Highly recommend the tour in Madrid. I would book the tour again and glad we did it. The architecture of the buildings and structures were really beautiful!

Fantastic day out. The cities were absolutely beautiful and the architecture was amazing. What really made this special was our guide Arantxa. Sometimes the bus rides can be a little monotonous but with her fun and upbeat attitude she pointed out highlights along the way which really made this in all inclusive tour. I highly recommend this tour to get out of Madrid and see some spectacular sights.

This is a bus tour with about 30 people to Avila first and Segovia second. Most of the time is spent within churches which were gorgeous. There are some pretty amazing sites to see. Our family favorite was the 2000 year old Roman aqueduct in Segovia.

Booked thru Get Your Guide, but tour was provided by Fun and Tickets Madrid. Great experience. Our guides German, Ely and Lola, were fantastic. Avila is a beautiful city with a lot of history. The well conserved walls are impressive !!!
In Segovia, I have the opportunity of visit the famous Aqueduct. It was a dream of all my life. And this tour gave me the opportunity of be there. It was awesome !!!
However, I must suggest that the places visited, specially in Avila, must be reduced. So, you can have more time available to explore Segovia, which I believe requires more time to enjoy all interesting places it have to offer.
But it was a great tour. No doubt...

What a fabulous tour! Two beautiful cities in Spain with 100’s of years of history still in place. Our team was German and Irene as tour guides and Leticia as our driver. Leticia did a fantastic job managing the huge bus we were on. We felt very safe in her capable hands. Irene was the guide who gave us the tour in both cities. She was very knowledgeable, had a great sense of humor, and made sure we were doing well as we did our guided walks. Overall, it was a gold star tour which we highly recommend! Thank you Irene, Leticia and German!

Kathy Flores and Jim Jimenez

Irene (English tour guide) was excellent - she was knowledgeable and conducted the tour of Segovia and Avila at the perfect pace. When my husband could not do the entire Segovia walk, she was helpful in calling a taxi and ensured the taxi came when needed. Very thoughtful of all her clients.

Really cool opportunity to see two UNESCO world cultural sites. Great guide, Rafael. You won’t be disappointed, unless you are the cranky woman who was mad that her bus seat wasn’t perfect that Rafael handled very well.

Full day. Great sights. Would like to have a little more free time to see Avila esp walking the walls. Would avoid eating at their promoted restaurant in Avila. Lots of other restaurants with better food and prices. They need to repair the two large windshield cracks on the bus, kind of scary.

Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable and spoke multiple languages (very helpful for those that do not speak fluent Spanish). The tour was nicely organized and the bus was very comfortable and clean. My next trip I plan to visit Toledo with the same company.

I was extremely happy with the experience! Oscar and Irene were extremely knowledgeable and charismatic. Everything about the tour went smoothly and they took their time to explain the history of the sites and answer any questions. I would definitely recommend this trip for anyone visiting Madrid!

Excellent day tour to two of the most magical places I’ve ever been to. Rafael is a great guide. He tells all these stories that makes it 75% of the experience. It allows you to get immersed in the past and enjoy the attractions even more. I would recommend these guys in a heartbeat.

Excelente tour a dos de los lugares mas mágicos que he visitado. Rafael es un gran guía. Las historias que el cuenta hacen el 75% de toda la experiencia. Le permite a uno sumergirse en el pasado y disfrutar de las atracciones aun mas. No dudaría en recomendar a estos tíos.

Saludos desde Uruguay.

The tour was very interesting since the guide was well versed in the history of Spain. The views of both Avila and Segovia were gorgeous. Each city had a quaint vibe and good options for food or snacks. The tour was certainly worth it.

Great tour, I can totally recommend it! We booked the tour without entry to the monuments because we prefer to explore some parts on our own and it worked perfectly fine. Rafael was a very cool tour guide and you can ask any question. (1 drink & tapas included)

Oscar was a wonderful guide who went above and beyond to point out monuments and landmarks on the whole tour, even the bus ride. He was a joy to be around and I would highly recommend this tour. Avila and Segovia were very interesting and cute towns.

The trip was very good, our tour guide Arantxa was nice and these 2 cities are definitely worth a visit. The organisation was good but the only negative was the large group size which made movement in general a bit slow. Other than that, it was a pretty good tour.

This was a very enjoyable day away from the hustle and bustle of Madrid. Avila is beautiful - it almost seems as if modern life has passed it by! And the views of the aqueduct and castle in Segovia will live long in my memory. Christina was a friendly, knowledgeable and professional guide for the day - she even included a very funny Boris Johnson joke …

This was a quick, informative trip through Avila and Segovia. Our tour guide Irene was very well-versed and demonstrated knowledge of both cities. She knew where to stop for breaks and how to pace the tour to allow for the best experience for everyone.

It was fun despite of of a long trip, They were always on time and the visiting towns were very interesting. The guider, Irene, is knowledgeable and funny. She pointed out many interesting facts on the streets, on the walls and inside the monuments. This trip is highly recommended.
Really a great way to spend a day out of Madrid seeing another side of Spain. Irene was a great guide providing great context to what we saw. The bus was comfortable and the tour well paced

This was an excellent tour! Rafael met my wife and me on time with great energy and clear directions. He did a great job of pointing out interesting facts about Avila and Segovia - the two cities we visited. The Spanish tour guides were knowledgeable and dynamic. Even our lunch restaurant was good, even though we were crunched for time (as they had warned us in advance). Everyone was friendly and helpful. I’d recommend this tour to tourists.

What an amazing tour this was! We did this on October 5, 2022 and the weather was perfect! We had a wonderful tour guy, the tour bus was clean and comfy. The only issue that day was the AC wasn’t working on the bus at all but it wasn’t unbearably hot or uncomfortable for us. The tour was still GREAT of the two cities! Beware if you can’t walk that well or long.. don’t go. It’s a lot of walking. It’s a lot of walking up a hill, down a hill, walking everywhere. WEAR comfortable sneakers or walking shoes! Overall, we are pleased with this tour and would suggest to our friends and family if they are in Madrid to definitely book this tour from this company.

This was truly an amazing tour. We have taken a few tours here and most are dual language. This one was totally in English. That made it much nicer for us.. Our tour guide Raphael was the best- he was very knowledgeable and added a bit of humor. The sites were fabulous. Climbing to the top of the aqueduct is a must! (Going on top of the wall was pretty special too) Thanks Raphael for a great tour!

This was our first organized tour and it was very enjoyable. We were able to save time and confusion on getting to the destinations with a convenient meeting place, comfortable bus and efficient staffing at Fun & TIckets. Betty was an excellent guide, knowledgeable, patient and professional. We were able to see the major sites at a pleasant pace and had some free time in both cities so that the tour group could do activities they chose to (i.e. climb up to the aqueduct, explore other areas etc.).

Highly recommend this tour. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and knew her history. We did plenty of walking which was great but the tour did accommodate those with disabilities by providing a cab to the different spots.
The tour bus was very comfortable and our tour guide was fun, knowledgeable and very friendly.
We love you Arancha!

Thank you Rafael for the amazing guided tour. He did an excellent job introducing the history and stories of Segovia and Avila along the tour. The trip itself was well organised, many bathroom stops/short rests to break up the day. Wear comfy shoes as there are some uneven roads.

This is a fabulous tour of Tolédo! Oscar was a wonderful guide - very friendly and knowledgeable about all things Tolédo. The tour was well paved with a couple of short breaks and a little over an hour at lunch to eat and shop. I highly recommend it!

Great one day trip to see both cities. I liked the balance of the time visiting the sites but also relaxing for a few minutes to enjoy complimentary tortilla and a drink (I had delicious tinto de verano). Irene was a good guide and maintained us interested throughput the visits

This was a last minute trip for me and I highly recommend booking this tour!! Arantxa was my tour guide and she made it very exciting, she was very friendly and knew a lot about the history of Toledo. We did a lot of walking but we stopped enough so it’s manageable. Definitely recommend doing this tour if you’re visiting Madrid.

Raphael as a guide was excellent. I give it 4 stars because the tour spent too much time in churches which didn’t leave much time to enjoy the main highlights. In Avila, I had a choice to either eat or walk the top of the walls. Similarly, in Segovia, while we spent a lot of time roaming the streets and the church, there was hardly any time to explore the aquaduct or have some free time to relax. Otherwise, the tour was very well organised. Raphael was quite knowledgeable, witty and answered questions happily.

Rafa was an excellent tour guide. Yes knowledgeable and kept with the group. He was patient when asked questions and walked at at very steady good pace. We truly enjoyed it and would highly recommend him for tours!

Wonderful day with Pilar. She was a kind, gracious, knowledgeable guide. She was able to accommodate all the different travelers in the group. As an airline crew member who has travelled to almost all the continents ( save Australia and Greenland) I have participated in many different types of guided tours and
I was pleasantly surprised by the balance maintained between the monuments, museums, and free time. Thank you, Pilar for sharing with all of us your knowledge and patriotic pride!

Muchas Gracias!

What a great activity to see and to learn abour Avila/Segovia! Guides are really interesting and take time to answer our questions/requests. Would be perfect I we had more free time to walk around Segovia. We recommand !

If you want to enjoy history and architecture of these two medieval cities, moving quickly but with plenty of breaks, this is a great tour. Rafa was so knowledgeable and made sure to engage all your members throughout the day. The stops for coffee/lunch/breaks are just long enough, and you get to see so much in a day. Great price for the service, we recommend it!

Irene was very knowledgeable and detailed on the history of each of the landmarks. She and the driver were punctual and clear on meeting time. She made sure everyone is accounted for and no one is left behind before leaving a landmark. I highly recommend this trip with he.

Óscar was our tour guide. He was very patient and kind all the time. Provided us great historic details in each place.

They give you time to go to restrooms and have a snack in between so that was very much appreciated.

Bus is really comfortable for long rides and very clean.

In general, my experience was very good.☺️
Germán and Irene were excellent guides. Always taking care of the group and giving good explanations. My only suggestion would be to give more free time (lunch time) in Segovia rather than in Avila.

Very good! It felt like we were able to see all of the highlights without being too rushed. The sights were beautiful and the tour guides were incredibly knowledgeable and helpful. Highly recommend! Definitely worth the money!

Gloria (Tour guide at Avila) and Mariano (at Segovia) were excellent excellent excellent!! Excellent organization, explained thoroughly, funny, and above all, patient with the group. Super organized, precise on time, and gave us enough time for pictures, bathroom breaks, water, etc. Highly recommended!! A+++++++
Thank you!!
—-
Hernandez-Benitez Family
Puerto Rico

The interior of the Alcazar castle was very interesting and well displayed. The Cathedral of Avila, I did on my own; also very interesting. Apparently there is much more to be seen, but this was a very good first encounter. Compliments for the guide Raphael: very well informed, had his own message and was not a ‘pleaser’.

Great tour. A lot to be seen in both Avila and Segovia. We were well looked after by our driver Letizia, our guides Maria and Rafa.
The group was split for English and Spanish - we had Rafa for the English tours of the destinations. Very knowledgeable and kept things interesting.
It was well worth getting the monument tickets included as Rafa then guided us through them.

Too much time allowed for Avila and too little time for Segovia which is much more interesting. We spent 3 hours in Avila which I think should be cut to 1.5 hours because there isn’t much to do there. Tapas included was just one small slice of tortilla and 2 little slices of bread. We wish we were allowed more time in Segovia to try the famous Cochinillo dish.

Very interesting, great views and easy to understand tour. The guide was nice and funny. The Royal Palace in Segovia is very well preserved and beautiful and you can visit much of it and see a lot from the time period. Worth the trip!

Well the everything was great, the views where beautiful and the guide was very informative. The only thing that bother me a bit was that the tour was a bit rush do to one of the people that came with us had plans and wanted to be in Madrid exactly at 6:30pm. So basically the guide rushed all of us because of that one person. So my tip for all of you is if you come please make your plans after 8pm. But other than that great tour, I just wished it was not so rushed.

Lovely tour, the 2 cities are amazing and we were happy to see both in a single day.
Very knowledgeable guides (Cristina and Helena) and comfortable bus.
I would just like to have spent less time at the Santa Teresa convento in Avila, would have preferred to go walk on top of the walls instead. The story of Santa Teresa is insteresting but could have been told on the bus.

A really well done tour. There were a lot of great sites visited with some personal flex time as well. Segovia was absolutely stunning. Oscar was a fantastic guide - a fully bilingual experience . Highly recommend!

We had an amazing very well planned and structured visit. The tourist guide Irene was quite welcoming, good English translation, she was informational and had a good sense of humor.
Would recommend this trip, with the same team and Irene as the guide.
Only the Internet in the bus was not working.

Our guide Rafael was very informative with the locations and the history. He did not rush he always asked if we had questions. Which was great. A lot of times you are being talked to, but not able to ask questions.
He made it very enjoyable.
Maria gave a lot of information while we were on the bus.

The guide Oscar and his team saved our day. We started with technical problems on the bus, and there were annoying people, we believed that the good experience we had in the royal palace was not going to be repeated, but thanks to the professionalism of Oscar who knew how to train the group and his team, Rafe I think the other guide is called, we had an incredible day.
Avila and Segovia are magical and transport you back in time, as if you were in a movie.

It was really amazing, you wil never regret.
Irena is the best tour gide as far i have. She enjoys really haar work, she males fun an tels you about the history of every place.

The guide was fantastic. So we’ll
Informed on the history of Spain and went great lengths to explain the history of the things we were seeing. He was friendly in addition to professional. We walk around 4 mi which wasn’t bad given all what we saw but that should be taken into consideration if you have small children

It was really interesting. We had an amazing day with Maria and Hermann and their explanations were very good.

Perhaps it could be better to spend more free time in the 2 towns (especially in Segovia we can find some nice shops)

Thank you so much for this visit !!

Wear comfortable sneakers. A lot of walking. We did Segovia and Avila. Lot’s of history with cathedrals and basilica. I recommend Fun & tickets host. Lunch was the egg tortilla but you can order more and pay for extra.

We enjoyed very much the experience of learning the history and culture ch of the sites we visited. Rafael and German were excellent in their disposition to guide and educate. Rafa and Maria are amazing tour guides. They made our Sunday trip to Avila and Segovia a memorable family trip. We loved every moment of it. I highly recommend taking this tour either in English or Spanish.

Great trip overall. The two cities we went to were interesting and learned a lot from our guide Rafa. He’s very knowledgeable. If you’re a history buff this tour is for you. Rafael was our tour guide and did an amazing job leading our group. He described the buildings and history so clearly and answered our questions with ease. The tour was organized well.

This is a wonderful tour to take if you enjoy; history, architecture, religion, good food, and spectacular views.
We had a full day of exploring Cathedrals, Alcazar of Segovia, Basilica of Avila, and an impressive Aqueduct in Segovia.

Our tour guide was excellent and gave us a good overview of the history of both cities. Segovia was a much more interesting place to me than Avila, and felt less touristy. Using the bus tour is definitely the way to go.

Kind of unexpected, still wonderful.
Segovia and Avila are two nice cities but what makes the difference really is the guide! Irene was ours throughout the day and she was magic. Funny still with the absolute and full aknwoledge of the matter. A fun fuct for every and each spot of the visit. I do recommend to book this one day excursion, although it is exhausting it is worth the pain. Would book others experiences with them!
Last but not least, thank you to Irene and Laeticia who was the perfect driver which made the trip comfortable!

This experience was great. Both Oscar and Hernan were very good and knowledgeable. I took the Spanish guide (Hernan) and to me Hernan was super knowledgeable. Aquaduct was by far my favorite part. Tour guide (Irene) was very knowledgeable and did a nice job of shepherding all of us. We ditched the recommended lunch option and found a nice restaurant 3 minutes away. We needed the rest at the end of the tour - lots of walking. Overall, a good day.

Our guide Oscar was very knowledgeable and swift on his feet. Too fast for some of us on a very hot day. We could have used more breaks and time to explore independently.

That said, we enjoyed the tour immensely and highly recommend it.

Loved it!! We took a full day tour with Rafael. He was Very patient and was communicating in Spanish as well as very fluently in English for non Spanish speaking visitors like us. We got to know a lot about Spanish history through this tour. Ample time was given at each monument and meal/ break times were well planned

Hi everyone!
I came to Madrid 2 months ago cause of the univertsity (Erasmus) and i choose this service randomly but they got me really impressed.
Christie was a nice person, professional and so smart.
She showed us 2 incredible cities, the history, food, monuments and other things.
I really recommend this!!

Good tour if you’re looking for an easy way to get to Avila and Segovia and learn a lot of information.
We enjoyed it, but i wouldn’t say it was a “fun” tour. Obviously very touristy in a large group, but that’s to be expected. Probably wouldn’t recommend for younger kids, as they’d probably get bored.
The tapas included was ok, not great.
Our guide was very knowledgeable and very easy to understand. The transportation was the best, perfect ride for napping on the way there and back.

Excellent tour of these areas. Our guide Heidi (Irene?) was amazing. Was so knowledgeable about everything and was genuinely excited to share stories with us. It was a long day so be sure you wear comfortable shoes and bring water. Thank you!!
Irene was great. We got to see a lot of Alvia and Segovia. Irene gave us a lot of good information. I wish we had a little more time to explore the city and see all the small shops in the city.

Overall this was a great experience. Everything was very well organized and punctual. The bus was nice and comfortable for the long drives between the towns.
Our tour guide Raphael was extremely knowledgeable and kept us well entertained. I would highly recommend this tour to family and friends.

An unforgettable day. We learnt so much thanks to our wonderful guide Irene who took special care of us all day. Amazed of how much information, sights and history we experienced in such a short amount of time . The guiding was very professional, friendly and fun.
Worth every penny .

Great city tour, nice schedule–not too fast and not too slow. Great explanations from the guide (Raphael and Elizabeth). Quite unfortunate that it rained a little bit at the beginning and at the end. Overall it was an excellent experience!

We had a great time with our tour guide, Eden (Irene), who was a fantastic speaker. The pacing of the tour was just right, and there was ample time to explore the two cities. Eden was very knowledgeable and engaging, and answered our many questions. Would definitely go again!

Rafa has so much knowledge to share during our visit to Segovia and Avila. I love how he mix the the Spanish history from early ages to the current. He is like a walking encyclopedia of the Spanish heritage. This tour is awesome! Rafa made this tour educational, entertaining and interactive.

Over all, this tour was superb! I highly recommend Rafa’s tours for his knowledge and wealth of information. Great job Mr Rafa

My husband and I completed the tour of Avila and Segovia. We had a great trip Irene was an excellent guide and very knowledgeable. She included the group and made everyone feel welcome. The tours were both fascinating. Next time I hoe to bring my kids.

Irene Diaz Terreno was our guide and she was absolutely fantastic. She was very knowledgable and informative about every site we visited. We enjoyed it very much. These were two of our favorite cities and tours in Spain. I had completed the114 km Sarria to Santiago Camino and we were here visiting after that. This was a real treat to visit two other Camino locations in Spain on a different Camino trail.

Don’t hesitate! We had beautiful views snd a comfortable ride. History came to life through our excellent guides. Rafael led English speakers. He is very knowledgeable and makes things fun as well. Segovia was especially fascinating. Recommended for adults.

It was good and it was very nice places too see. For me, I didn’t understand all the time when the tour guide spoke and I lost a little content that way, but it was generally good! Irene was a great guide. She was very knowledgeable of the many monuments and sites. She made the tour fun with her upbeat personality and it was a really goood time. Avila and Segovia are amazing and this tour is a cant miss.

Really glad Ralph is our tour guide for the Ávila and Segovia day tour.
He explains things clearly and has a good sense of humor. Def will rec him and this tour for people looking to explore outwards from Madrid.

We had a wonderful time on this tour. Rafa is a great guide, very knowledgeable, very humble and helpful. His recommendations when it comes to food is superb. The bus journey is also very comfortable. Will recommend Fun & Tickets for all tours in and around Madrid.

Excellent and comfortable bus, great English tour guide. Certainly great places to visit. Be ready to pay for your breakfast and lunch in addition. We had a full day tour with Irene and it was done very well. We were a very big group and she managed to engage all. Time management was good and we all ended up save and sound on the bus. We have a problem with the ticket type that we bought and she sorted it all then an there!

This tour was worth every penny. Shout out to our tour guide Nuria for being so knowledgeable on everything. She is very Informative regarding the cities history. If you have an extra day to spare this is a beautiful way to spend it. There’s so much history to take in and beautiful sites to see.

The Ávila and Segovia tour was really fantastic. The guide Raffa is very personable and competent! The program is varied and a lot of fun. You get great tips from Raffa and you feel in good hands! thank you for the great day. In addition, the price-performance ratio is right! We recommend!

Note: I write better in English. I liked the Town Hall and the Plaza del Mercado Chico. It was a big place but felt intimate, the kind of place to meet friends. Took the day trip, all was well organised and timed so well. Lot of details and explanation were given to all the sites. We had good time at both the cities and being a long tour, the energy levels of Diego and Antonio were really welcoming. Would surely recommend this tour to people to take :)

Tour was good. Time in each city was limited but well spent given the short time. Would have been nicer to visit more of the cathedrals.

Overall really good experience and would highly recommend if you need to see both cities in a single day.

Great day trip to Avila and Segovia. Raphael was our tour guide and he was very informative. He never rushed us and we were a large group. He was also able to keep everyone together. Be glad if you get him as your guide!

Pilar was one of the best guides I’ve ever had. She was charming friendly and very knowledgeable . We saw the major sights in both cities and had a bit of free time to explore on our own. I highly recommend this tour

Rafael was the best tour guide I have ever had! He was so knowledgeable and funny and had excellent speaking and teaching skills in Spanish and English. I was so entertained by him the entire time for the whole 9 hours. Everything about the tour was perfect. You get so much for your money. I learned so much about the history of Avila and Segovia and their beautiful monuments. Definitely recommend it. You will not regret it.

This tour exceeded our expectations. It was a very full day but it was not rushed. We had plenty of time to enjoy Avila, and Segovia. Highlights were walking the walls and the tour of the castle with Irene ! This tour was a good value snd we appreciated our bus driver getting us there and back safely !

Seeing multiple cities on one day was not an easy task, somehow this tour is not only fun but also not overwhelming and tiresome. Love all the details and plans.

Our tour guide Ravi was informative, friendly, and made our trip more fun. Will definitely recommend it to everyone else.

The bus was very nice and had AC. The guides were very informative and friendly. You won’t have much time to explore on your own as the tour is fast paced. What I loved most is being able to see so much in one day. Be ready to walk.

We had a great day at both the old cities as we have a wonderful guide, Rafael. He answered all the queries in fluent English and made our trip a memorable one. Totally recommend this day trip and thank you Rafael.

This was a great tour! The sites are amazing at these two locations. Irene and Rafa were excellent guides and have really good historic commentary. We had a great tour with Oscar and Irene! Irene led our group and was very knowledgeable at both locations and fun. Our kids enjoyed everything. So as long as you know you will not have time to explore the shops.

Iré a, Elli and Coral were wonderful guides. Pablo was our driver and took good care of us. Avila and Segovia are amazing cities and I would love to return and spend much more time exploring. Una visita muy linda con guías excelentes.

The team of Oscar, Rafael and Likisha(?) the driver was fantastic. They were very professional, knowledgeable and accommodating. The trip was well planned and timely. Everything went well from the start to finish. I will strongly recommend this trip to anybody visiting Madrid.

Trip to Avila and Segovia was excellent. Our guide Raffi was very knowledgeable and English was fluent. He gave us all the details and the history of each monument. But overall, it was well worth it.

This was a fantastic tour. The guides Gloria, Hernan and Rafa were fantastic. A lot of history in these cities and our guides were the perfect teachers.

A couple of things that could be better. The meeting point of the tour is a little confusing. I would recommend to have someone from the company there prior to arrival time. Also I would not include the gourmet lunch. That was extremely disappointing.

Very enjoyable day with our guide Irene who was both humorous and informative. Coach driver very professional

This is my first time visiting Spain. Booked this full day tour. The tour guide Rafael(Rafa) was great! He was informative and well versed. One of the best tours I have been on. This is a must when visiting Madrid.

Day tour from Madrid to Avila and Segovia exhausting but worth the money. Learned and saw beautiful site thanks to Germàn ,Elena and Gloria. They were courteous, friendly and helpful. My only negative if any, was I wish I could of stayed and enjoyed a bit more the surrounding area. 1/2 -1 hour was not enough. But I do understand the time constraints on a tour like this. Would definitely come back on our own. Thank you for a memorable day.

We had the best day. The trip, the beauty, the history, the commentary from our delightful and informative guide Arantxa made this a memorable visit. A must do if in Madrid. A nice break from bustle and heat of the city. The historic towns were an unexpected gem straight out of a storybook.
12/10 experience.
Oscar and German were good hosts. Their accents made the tour even better. The trip made seeing Spain easy. The stops were easy and they were able to tour us through the highlights of Segovia.

Being from the United States, our history only goes back so far and we don’t have a lot of structures that are more than 300 or 400 years old. Raffa was an excellent guide who was very kind and knowledgeable. Highly recommend this tour.
Very charming tour guide. Sites are worth the trip. Very scenic, historic and a sense of awe and magnificence. Tour company were timely, very comfortable buses and good pace of sights over the tour

I had a beautiful and informative experience of Historical Madrid Spain. There is such beautiful history and architecture here, 5/5 recommend. I have such beautiful pictures and memories of these two towns. Thank you to the tour guide Irene who was so informative and made the tour 10 times more interesting! Must see is the cathedrals

The tour was well organised and included the many amazing sites in both Avila and Segovia. The tour guides were very knowledgeable and had very good English and the audio head sets worked perfectly.

There is a lot to fit into a one day tour so at times it felt a little rushed - I could have spent longer at the alcazar and basilica in Segovia but this isn't really a criticism of the tour as they have so much to pack in.

The bus was very comfortable - however WiFi would have been a good addition.

Great tour, we walked around both of the towns. Weather was chiller in Avila, then it was in segovia. our guide was well educated, knew a lot about the history, also very friendly. Will definitely have to come back with the family.

An outstanding tour and our guide Raffael was excellent!! Very knowledgeable and funny too 👌 He made it fun for the group. I would definitely recommend this tour. The snack and drink were a bonus…the Café con Letche at the Resturant was terrific! Thanks for that.?

This is probably one of the best tours I have been on. Rafael was my tour guide and he was incredible! Great trip from Madrid that makes the best of two cities in one day!

Went with my 17 year old son - great time together. It was a really good introduction to the areas so we can plan our visits for another time in greater detail….truly should spend more time in both of those cities.

Great day that had lots of information and travel packed in. Luxury bus with a fantastic guide in Diego. He was detailed and clear with his information about the places we visited. Beautiful not to be missed cities. I would highly recommend this tour

The entire day was excellent. Irene, Michael and the driver was fabulous, funny, knowledgeable and genuine joy tour guide! The bus was very comfortable. Spain is such a Beautiful country and rich with history. The agenda was great with a full agenda but time to eat and enjoy the sights

Good guide- Arancha. She was very kind and knowledgable and took care of everyone very well.

Great tour. All day. Lots of walking but few spots to rest too. Ariantxa tour guide is excellent. Very nice and knowledgeable. You will see all major sites in both cities. Tour bus was nice and airconditioned. Very good experience we recommend it.

Really good day out, the sites of Avila and Segovia are well worth the trip. Didn't feel rushed at any time and it was no issue with us skipping a couple of basilica.

Enjoyed the stories that came along with the tour and they are were kind and patient with the group. The tour guides cared about everybody’s well being and encouraged the group to be more involved. Thanks Rafa, Hernan, Luis ,and Gloria for the amazing tour and the experience.

Excellent tour to take from madrid. All staff were awesome. The lead tour guide, Paco, was great. Very caring and knowledgeable individual.

The trip was very enjoyable. I read a good amount of reviews of the tour before attending and having been, can attribute a good amount of complaints to people not paying attention.
I suggest purchasing the version of this trip which includes the admissions, having a guided tour was of great value. The complaints from people about tour guides being rude when not purchasing these admissions, I felt was false. They were politely asked to do their tours independently out of respect for the persons who paid the extra fees.
Pay attention to which food option you book, there are several options: nothing, small lunch, full lunch. Even if you get nothing or small plate, there is good opportunity to grab food at a local place.
Prepare for lots of walking. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a camera! I wouldn't call the tour rushed, but there were some places I could have spent more time. It would have been cool to walk the walls in Avila. It also would have been cool to go up in the tower in the castle in Segovia.
Finding your tour group can be a little confusing, especially if you do not speak Spanish. The tour office is inside a small mall shopping area, set back from the view of the street. When you buy a voucher online, bring it to the desk so they can give you your day ticket and assign your group number. If you do not visit the desk, you will have no idea which group is yours as the voucher does not contain this information.
